description: This Java class implements the MerchantConfigurationService, providing methods for managing merchant configuration data within an e-commerce system. It includes functionalities to retrieve, save, update, and delete merchant configurations, as well as to handle merchant-specific configurations stored as JSON strings.

classes.name: MerchantConfigurationServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the MerchantConfigurationService interface, managing merchant configuration entities, including retrieval, saving, updating, and deleting configurations, as well as JSON serialization/deserialization for merchant configs.

methods.name: getMerchantConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves a merchant configuration based on key and store.

methods.name: listByType
methods.description: Lists configurations by specified configuration type and store.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new or updates an existing merchant configuration entity.

methods.name: getMerchantConfig
methods.description: Retrieves merchant-specific configuration, deserializing from JSON.

methods.name: saveMerchantConfig
methods.description: Serializes and saves merchant configuration as JSON.
